data.thesis_note_en: 10 reviewed stories and brand cases covering campaign actions, measurement, Hong Kong payment tools and creative workflows.

items.title: Supermetrics擴展Claude廣告操作，新活動預設暫停待審批
items.title_en: Supermetrics expands Claude campaign actions with new campaigns paused for approval
items.summary: 11月3日公告把跨平台資料分析、活動建立與修改放進同一對話流程。
items.summary_en: The November 3 announcement connects cross-platform analysis with campaign creation and editing.
highlights: 新建活動先暫停，審閱批准後才啟用。
Context Layer可保存目標、命名規則及客戶與帳戶對應。
highlights_en: New campaigns remain paused until reviewed and approved.
Context Layer carries targets, naming rules and client-account mappings.
items.why: 代理商可把客戶規則帶入AI分析，同時明確區分提案、修改及正式投放的權限。
items.why_en: Agencies can bring client rules into analysis while separating proposals, edits and activation.
items.next_step: 先用測試帳戶確認各平台支援範圍，逐一設好審批要求。
items.next_step_en: Check supported actions in a test account and configure approval requirements.
items.detail: 按公司公告，Claude可使用已連接的廣告、CRM、電商等資料，再建立或修改活動。公司列出Google Ads、Meta、Microsoft Advertising、TikTok、LinkedIn及Snapchat，未逐項交代所有活動類型是否支援相同操作。Context Layer可按團隊、平台或帳戶保存業務規則；現有活動的建議修改可先審閱，客戶亦可設定不同帳戶的批准要求。本報未實測權限或操作。
items.detail_en: The release names six ad platforms but does not itemize equal action support for every campaign type. Business rules can apply at team, platform or account level. Proposed edits can be reviewed, with account-specific approval requirements. These are vendor descriptions, not tested permissions.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Smartly推出Intelligence Pro，把媒體規劃與增量訊號放進同一平台
items.title_en: Smartly launches Intelligence Pro for media planning and incrementality signals
items.summary: Smartly於11月2日推出付費進階服務，供符合資格的客戶使用。
items.summary_en: Smartly announced a premium service for eligible customers on November 2.
highlights: Reach Planner預測跨渠道觸及與頻次；Headroom Analysis評估加碼空間。
INCRMNTAL Connect把增量貢獻訊號與平台數據並列。
highlights_en: Reach Planner forecasts reach and frequency; Headroom Analysis assesses spending headroom.
INCRMNTAL Connect adds contribution signals alongside platform reporting.
items.why: 媒體團隊可在規劃預算時，同時查看平台表現與額外生意貢獻的估算。
items.why_en: Media teams can compare platform performance with estimates of additional business contribution.
items.next_step: 先問清楚數據需求、模型假設及方案資格，再用一個市場作比較。
items.next_step_en: Check data requirements, model assumptions and eligibility, then compare one market.
items.detail: 這項服務亦包括Benchmarks，以彙總及匿名數據，按行業、地區、平台及目標比較表現。四項工具處理規劃、加碼空間、同業比較與增量訊號等不同問題，不能把預測或模型估算直接當成已實現收入。官方列明只供符合資格的Smartly客戶使用，未公布統一價格；新聞稿中的客戶感言亦不代表所有廣告主可獲相同結果。
items.detail_en: Benchmarks uses aggregated, anonymized data across industries, regions, platforms and objectives. Forecasts and modeled incrementality are not realized revenue. Eligibility applies; the release gives no standard price or universal outcome guarantee.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 6sense公布代理式GTM更新，BDR與AI可見度功能分階段測試
items.title_en: 6sense announces agentic GTM updates with staged BDR and AI Visibility betas
items.summary: 6sense於11月3日公布新定位及產品安排，多項能力仍屬測試階段。
items.summary_en: 6sense’s November 3 announcement sets out a new positioning and staged product availability.
highlights: BDR Agent於11月推出測試版；AI Visibility計劃12月測試。
Sales Intelligence MCP已正式提供；其他能力有各自時間表。
highlights_en: BDR Agent enters beta in November; AI Visibility beta is planned for December.
Sales Intelligence MCP is generally available; other features follow separate schedules.
items.why: B2B團隊採購代理工具時，需要按功能逐項查資格，不能以整體發布代替可用性核對。
items.why_en: B2B buyers should assess eligibility feature by feature rather than treating an announcement as full availability.
items.next_step: 按現有銷售流程，列出需要的訊號、操作及人手批准點，再詢問測試資格。
items.next_step_en: List required signals, actions and approval points before asking about beta access.
items.detail: GTM指把產品帶到市場、取得客戶的工作。6sense希望把買家情報接入人員與AI代理使用的工具，BDR Agent支援初步業務開發，AI Visibility則觀察品牌在AI答案中的呈現。公告把BDR、可解釋性及AI可見度列為不同階段，並未表示全部已正式開放。Sales Intelligence MCP提供相容代理查詢接入；公司預測能力與成效仍需由使用者評估，本報未引用其買家比例或勝率數字。
items.detail_en: GTM covers bringing products to market and acquiring customers. 6sense separates BDR outreach, explainability and AI-answer visibility into different release stages. Its MCP integration exposes intelligence to compatible agents. No buyer percentages or independently proven sales gains are asserted here.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Sunrate在香港推出代理付款卡，企業預先設定支出權限
items.title_en: Sunrate announces agent payment card with business-defined spending controls
items.summary: Sunrate於11月2日在香港金融科技周公布Agentic Card，涵蓋行銷支出等企業用途。
items.summary_en: Sunrate announced Agentic Card at Hong Kong FinTech Week on November 2, including marketing spending as a use case.
highlights: 企業可設定金額、貨幣、地區及有效期。
代理按已授權指示付款；操作可記錄及審核。
highlights_en: Businesses can set amount, currency, geography and validity controls.
Agents act on authorized instructions with auditable activity.
items.why: 讓代理處理媒體或供應商付款時，支出權限及例外審批要與自動化一同設計。
items.why_en: Automated media or supplier payments need spending permissions and exception approvals.
items.next_step: 由財務與媒體團隊共同核對商戶限制、審批及對賬流程。
items.next_step_en: Have finance and media teams review merchant restrictions, approvals and reconciliation.
items.detail: 按Sunrate公告，企業可為特定活動或付款任務建立多貨幣虛擬商業卡，預先設置授權規則，並在任務完成後自動到期。代理可建立卡、設定付款參數及取回交易結果，企業仍保留重要財務決策的監督。新聞稿以旅遊平台的活動支出作應用例子，未提供已量度的節省成效；實際申請資格、費用及可用地區仍需向供應商確認。
items.detail_en: Sunrate describes task-specific virtual cards that can expire on completion. Agents can configure payments and retrieve outcomes while businesses retain oversight. The travel-platform example is a proposed use case, not measured savings; confirm fees and eligibility.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Tripo推出Agentic Canvas，以可編輯節點串連3D製作
items.title_en: Tripo launches Agentic Canvas with editable 3D production workflows
items.summary: Tripo於11月2日公布新工作空間，可把生成、修改及匯出步驟連起來。
items.summary_en: Tripo announced a workspace connecting generation, refinement and export on November 2.
highlights: 代理可先生成流程，再由使用者檢查及修改節點。
流程可儲存、複製及批次套用到多個素材。
highlights_en: An agent proposes a workflow that users can inspect and edit.
Workflows can be saved, duplicated and applied to batches of assets.
items.why: 製作多個商品或場景素材的團隊，可評估重用流程能否改善交接與一致性。
items.why_en: Teams producing product or scene assets can evaluate reusable workflows for consistency and handover.
items.next_step: 先以一款產品試做，檢查幾何、貼圖、匯出格式與收費。
items.next_step_en: Test one product, checking geometry, textures, export formats and charges.
items.detail: 節點代表個別操作，連線把上一步輸出交給下一步。按公告，可加入貼圖、網格重整、UV處理及骨架設定等步驟，也可在AI 3D Lab用對話檢查或修改素材。這次重點是把既有3D能力組成可重用流程，並非證明所有輸出已適合商用。品牌仍需檢查實物比例、標誌與材質，以及素材權利和方案限制；公告沒有提供獨立生產成效測試。
items.detail_en: Nodes connect operations such as texturing, retopology, UV work and rigging. AI 3D Lab adds conversational inspection and refinement. Reusable workflows do not establish commercial readiness: brands still need to check product accuracy, rights and plan limits.

items.title: Hightouch把Match Booster帶到歐洲五國，補充第一方資料識別資訊
items.title_en: Hightouch launches Match Booster in five European markets
items.summary: Hightouch於11月3日宣布，服務在英國、德國、法國、西班牙及意大利推出。
items.summary_en: Hightouch announced availability in the UK, Germany, France, Spain and Italy on November 3.
highlights: 在同步至廣告平台時補充識別資訊，保留原有客戶記錄。
公司稱歐洲受眾在歐洲處理，可在同一工作空間管理美歐受眾。
highlights_en: Additional identifiers enrich records during sync without replacing customer records.
The company says European enrichment runs in Europe within a shared US/EU workspace.
items.why: 跨市場CRM投放團隊可檢查，受眾匹配及資料處理流程是否需要分開管理。
items.why_en: Cross-market CRM teams can review audience matching and regional processing workflows.
items.next_step: 先核對同意及退出規則，再用一組已授權受眾比較匹配結果。
items.next_step_en: Review consent and opt-out rules before comparing one consented audience.
items.detail: Match Booster是同步資料時增加識別資訊的工具，例如補充廣告平台可用的客戶識別線索，而不是取代企業原有第一方名單。這次公告列出五個推出市場，不能據此假設香港或其他市場同時可用。公司亦刊出試行匹配提升數字，並非獨立對照驗證；本報不沿用比例，也不把供應商的合規描述當成法律保證。實際處理位置、資料授權及費用需按合約核對。
items.detail_en: Match Booster enriches identifiers as audiences sync rather than replacing first-party lists. The announcement names five launch markets, not Hong Kong. Vendor pilot uplift and compliance claims are not independent proof or legal assurance; check processing, permissions and contract costs.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Friendbuy推出創作者管理工具，串連推薦、會員與後續購買資料
items.title_en: Friendbuy launches influencer software linking creator acquisition with repeat purchases
items.summary: Friendbuy於11月3日宣布Influencer正式提供，品牌可自行管理創作者及聯盟計劃。
items.summary_en: Friendbuy announced general availability of Influencer on November 3 for brand-managed creator and affiliate programs.
highlights: 管理邀請、活動、佣金及付款，並非創作者交易市場。
結合Referral與Loyalty後，可追蹤重複購買及推薦行為。
highlights_en: It manages invitations, campaigns, commissions and payouts rather than operating a marketplace.
With Referral and Loyalty, brands can follow repeat orders and referrals.
items.why: 品牌可把創作者帶來的首單與客戶後續行為連起來，減少只看一次轉換的盲點。
items.why_en: Brands can connect first creator-driven orders with later customer activity.
items.next_step: 先統一佣金歸因窗口、退貨處理及客戶資料欄位，再評估整合。
items.next_step_en: Align attribution windows, returns and customer fields before evaluating integration.
items.detail: 按公告與官方產品頁，品牌自行招募創作者，設定活動及分級佣金，透過Tremendous處理付款；工具可單獨使用，也可接入既有推薦及會員計劃。官方FAQ指佣金歸因受點擊後的設定窗口及購買驗證影響，因此資料連接不等於證明新增生意。網站刊出的Bathhouse推薦計劃數字，亦不代表新Influencer工具已產生相同結果。本報未引用該等成效。
items.detail_en: Brands recruit creators and configure tiered commissions, with payouts through Tremendous. It works alone or with Referral and Loyalty. Attribution depends on configured windows and purchase validation. Bathhouse referral-program results are not evidence of the new influencer product’s impact.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 品牌案例：Optimizely用懸疑短劇接觸B2B行銷人
items.title_en: Brand case: Optimizely uses a murder-mystery microdrama to reach B2B marketers
items.summary: 11月2日公告介紹Murder in Marketing：直式短劇已推出，長片計劃於11月13日首映。
items.summary_en: A November 2 announcement describes a live vertical series and a film premiere planned for November 13.
highlights: 直式短劇於10月30日開始，並非11月2日才首播。
內容分發至TikTok、Instagram、LinkedIn及YouTube Shorts。
highlights_en: The vertical series began October 30, before the announcement.
Distribution includes TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.
items.why: B2B品牌可從受眾熟悉的工作情境切入，評估故事內容能否引發同業討論。
items.why_en: B2B brands can explore workplace stories that invite discussion among professional audiences.
items.next_step: 先用一個真實工作矛盾寫短篇故事，再設定完播與後續互動指標。
items.next_step_en: Build a short story around a real workplace tension and define viewing and follow-up measures.
items.detail: 這部由Optimizely與Caspian Studios合作的作品，把行銷團隊的職場壓力放進虛構懸疑故事。公告區分已推出的直式短劇，以及計劃於11月13日首映的長片。本報將它作為AI行銷平台的品牌內容案例，並非宣稱影片由AI生成。公司希望以娛樂建立關係，尚未提供這個活動的獨立觀看或商業轉換結果；新聞稿引用的整體短劇市場數據亦未用來證明此案例有效。
items.detail_en: Optimizely and Caspian Studios turn workplace marketing pressures into fiction. This is a content-marketing case from an AI platform, not a claim of AI-generated production. The film is still scheduled; no independent campaign viewing or business-conversion result is established.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Sky News擴大Arc XP合作，新網站與App目標2027年底推出
items.title_en: Sky News expands Arc XP partnership for app and website targeted for end-2027
items.summary: Sky於11月2日公布平台合作，將影片及個人化放在新體驗中心。
items.summary_en: Sky announced a platform agreement focused on video and personalization on November 2.
highlights: 新網站與App仍在規劃，目標2027年底推出。
合作延續現有Ask Sky News對話式搜尋。
highlights_en: The new app and website are targeted for launch by end-2027.
The agreement builds on existing Ask Sky News conversational search.
items.why: 內容品牌可思考，如何把AI搜尋帶來的接觸轉成讀者直接回訪。
items.why_en: Content brands can examine how AI discovery might lead to direct audience relationships.
items.next_step: 先盤點自有網站的影片入口、訂閱路徑與讀者回訪指標。
items.next_step_en: Review video entry points, subscription journeys and return-visit measures.
items.detail: Arc XP將提供以AWS支援的媒體平台，包括手機應用、影片與個人化工具，配合Sky News 2030轉型。公告把新平台定位為建立直接讀者關係及探索付費產品的途徑，這些屬業務目標，尚非已實現成果。Ask Sky News是既有合作項目，不能把它寫成此次才推出；新網站與App亦未上線。本報未測試其搜尋質素或個人化成效。
items.detail_en: Arc XP will provide AWS-backed mobile, video and personalization tools for Sky News 2030. Direct audience growth and paid products are objectives, not established results. Ask Sky News already exists; the new app and website have not launched.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 案例：Travis以Finalytics調整網站內容，按訪客意圖呈現下一步
items.title_en: Case study: Travis uses Finalytics to adapt website content to visitor intent
items.summary: Finalytics於11月2日宣布，Travis Credit Union的個人化網站體驗已上線。
items.summary_en: Finalytics announced a live personalized website experience for Travis Credit Union on November 2.
highlights: 按網站行為調整內容、產品資訊及下一步。
供應商亦支援文案、優惠及報告；未公布轉換提升數據。
highlights_en: Website behavior informs content, offers and next steps.
The vendor also supports copy and reporting; no conversion uplift is reported.
items.why: 品牌做個人化時，可以先由訪客要完成的任務設計內容，再決定技術。
items.why_en: Brands can design personalization around visitor tasks before choosing technology.
items.next_step: 選一條查詢或申請路徑，定義完成率及人工覆核標準。
items.next_step_en: Choose one inquiry or application journey and define completion measures and review criteria.
items.detail: 按公司新聞稿，平台由訪客在網站上的行為判斷需要，例如了解首個戶口或比較汽車貸款，再調整頁面內容與提示。Finalytics亦提供背後的文案及報告支援，評估方向包括開戶與實際完成的貸款。這是供應商公布的客戶案例，並非獨立比較實驗；公告未列出轉換提升或對照組，因此不能推斷個人化必然增加收入，也不能套用到其他品牌。
items.detail_en: The vendor says site behavior informs pages for tasks such as opening an account or comparing auto loans. It supports content and reporting, measuring opened accounts and funded loans. This is an attributed customer case without a reported control group or uplift.
